ja.L: それゆえ、あなたのただ中で、父たちが息子たちを食べ、息子たちが自分たちの父たちを食べる。わたしはあなたに裁きを行い、あなたの残りの者をみな、あらゆる風に散らす。
ja.B: それゆえ、あなたの中で、{{gender:親|父親}}が{{gender:子|息子}}を食べ、{{gender:子|息子}}が{{gender:親|父親}}を食べる。わたしはあなたに裁きを行い、あなたの生き残った者をみな、あらゆる風に散らす。
ja.R: だから、町の中では、{{gender:親|父親}}が{{gender:子ども|息子}}を食べ、{{gender:子ども|息子}}が{{gender:親|父親}}を食べるようになる。わたしはあなたを罰し、生き残った者たちを四方八方に散らす。

decisions.choice: fathers will eat sons: the curse of Leviticus 26:29 and Deuteronomy 28:53
decisions.reason: Among the curses for breaking the covenant is that in the siege people will eat their own children (Leviticus 26:29; Deuteronomy 28:53-57). It happened in the siege of Samaria (2 Kings 6:28-29) and of Jerusalem (Lamentations 2:20; 4:10). Ezekiel adds that children will eat their parents. The words state the horror of famine in a siege without adding to it.

decisions.choice: to every wind: in every direction
decisions.reason: The four winds are the four directions (37:9). The survivors will be scattered all over the world, as the hair was scattered in verse 2.

decisions.choice: parents, children / fathers, sons (gender setting)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew words are "fathers" and "sons", but the horror meant falls on parents and children of both sexes (Lamentations 4:10 speaks of mothers). Literal keeps the Hebrew words; Balanced and Readable give the inclusive wording with the traditional words as the alternative. The register is kept plain and sober at every level.

decisions.choice: "부모", "자식" with no gender span (B, R); "아버지들", "아들들" (L)
decisions.reason: "부모" and "자식" are the plain Korean words for parents and children; Literal keeps the Hebrew's fathers and sons, so no span is needed.

decisions.choice: cha mẹ ... con cái (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English offers "parents, children / fathers, sons" as a setting. Literal keeps "cha" and "con"; Balanced and Readable say "cha mẹ" and "con cái", the inclusive sense, and need no second wording.

decisions.choice: "los padres", "los hijos", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "padres" and "hijos" already include mothers and daughters

decisions.choice: "tu remanente" (L, B); "los que queden" (R)
decisions.reason: Book-wide wording for the remnant, as Isaiah in Spanish

decisions.choice: pais, filhos, no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English puts "parents, children / fathers, sons" under the gender setting. Portuguese "pais" means parents as well as fathers, and "filhos" children as well as sons, so the one wording already says what the English default says (m1), and Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew words with no setting.

decisions.choice: "አባቶች ... ልጆች" (Literal); "ወላጆች ... ልጆች" (Balanced, Readable), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English offers "parents, children / fathers, sons" as a reader setting. "ልጆች" already covers sons and daughters, and Balanced and Readable say "ወላጆች" (parents), the setting's default, so there is no span; Literal keeps the Hebrew's "fathers".

decisions.choice: {{gender:माता-पिता|पिता}}, {{gender:सन्तान|पुत्र}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English does, Balanced and Readable offer "parents, children" by default and "fathers, sons" as the alternative; Literal keeps the Hebrew words with no span, as the English Literal does.

decisions.choice: बचे हुए (remnant)
decisions.reason: She'erit, "remnant", is बचे हुए लोग (L, B) as the prophets note settles.

decisions.choice: Gender spans as the English B, R: {{gender:親|父親}} and {{gender:子|息子}} (B), {{gender:子ども|息子}} (R); Literal "父たち", "息子たち" with no span, as the English L.
decisions.reason: The curse of Leviticus 26:29 (m1) means parents and children; Japanese has distinct inclusive words, so the setting works here as in Jeremiah 13:14.

source.text: לָכֵ֣ן חַי־אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ אִם־לֹ֗א יַ֚עַן אֶת־מִקְדָּשִׁ֣י טִמֵּ֔את בְּכָל־שִׁקּוּצַ֖יִךְ וּבְכָל־תּוֹעֲבֹתָ֑יִךְ וְגַם־אֲנִ֤י אֶגְרַע֙ וְלֹא־תָח֣וֹס עֵינִ֔י וְגַם־אֲנִ֖י לֹ֥א אֶחְמֽוֹל׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore [as] I live, declares [the] Lord Yahweh, surely because my sanctuary you have defiled with all your detestable things and with all your abominations, I also will diminish [you], and not will pity my eye, and also I not will spare.

en.L: Therefore, [as] I live, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, surely because {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sanctuary you have defiled with all your detestable things and with all your abominations, I too will cut [you] down; and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eye will not pity, and I also will not spare.
en.B: Therefore, as surely as I live, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, since you have made {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sanctuary unclean with all your vile idols and all your detestable practices, I myself will cut you down. I will not look on you with pity or spare you.
en.R: So, as surely as I live, says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, I will cut you down. You have made {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy place unclean with your disgusting idols and all your other disgusting things. I will not feel sorry for you or show you mercy.

pt.L: Portanto, [tão certo como] eu vivo, declara o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, certamente, porque contaminaste o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} santuário com todas as tuas coisas detestáveis e com todas as tuas abominações, eu também [te] cortarei; e o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} olho não terá piedade, e eu também não pouparei.
pt.B: Portanto, tão certo como eu vivo, declara o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, porque tornaste impuro o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} santuário com todos os teus ídolos vis e com todas as tuas práticas detestáveis, eu mesmo te cortarei. Não olharei para ti com piedade nem te pouparei.
pt.R: Por isso, tão certo como eu vivo, diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, eu vou te cortar. Tornaste impuro o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} lugar santo com os teus ídolos repugnantes e com todas as outras coisas repugnantes que fazes. Não vou ter pena de ti nem te mostrar misericórdia.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, [kama] niishivyo, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, hakika kwa kuwa umepatia unajisi patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} kwa vitu vyako vyote vya kuchukiza na kwa machukizo yako yote, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} pia nitakukata; wala jicho {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} halitahurumia, wala {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} sitaachilia.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo, hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, kwa kuwa umepatia unajisi patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} kwa sanamu zako zote za kuchukiza na matendo yako yote ya kuchukiza, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} nitakukata. Sitakutazama kwa huruma wala sitakuachilia.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo, hakika kama niishivyo, anasema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, nitakukata. Umepafanya mahali {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} patakatifu kuwa najisi kwa sanamu zako za kuchukiza na mambo yako mengine yote ya kinyaa. Sitakuonea huruma wala sitakuhurumia.

ko.L: 그러므로 내가 살아 있음을 [두고 맹세한다]. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 선언이다. 너는 너의 모든 혐오스러운 것들과 너의 모든 가증한 일로 내 성소를 더럽혔으니, 나도 [너를] 깎아 버리겠다. 내 눈이 불쌍히 여기지 않고, 나도 아끼지 않겠다.
ko.B: 그러므로 내가 살아 있음을 두고 맹세한다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다. 너는 너의 온갖 역겨운 우상들과 역겨운 짓으로 내 성소를 더럽혔다. 그러므로 나도 너를 베어 버리겠다. 나는 너를 불쌍히 여기지 않고 아끼지도 않겠다.
ko.R: 그러므로 내가 살아 있음을 두고 맹세한다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다. 나는 너를 베어 버리겠다. 너는 더러운 우상들과 온갖 역겨운 일로 내 거룩한 곳을 더럽혔다. 나는 너를 불쌍히 여기지도, 봐주지도 않겠다.

vi.L: Vì vậy, [thật như] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hằng sống, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, chắc chắn vì ngươi đã làm ô uế đền thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng mọi vật đáng ghê tởm của ngươi và bằng mọi điều ghê tởm của ngươi, nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ chặt bỏ [ngươi]; mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không thương xót, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ không dung tha.
vi.B: Vì thế, thật như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hằng sống, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, vì ngươi đã làm ô uế đền thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng mọi thần tượng gớm ghiếc và mọi việc làm ghê tởm của ngươi, nên chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chặt bỏ ngươi. Ta sẽ không đoái nhìn ngươi với lòng thương xót, cũng không dung tha ngươi.
vi.R: Vậy, thật như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hằng sống, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chặt bỏ ngươi. Ngươi đã làm ô uế nơi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng những thần tượng ghê tởm và mọi việc ghê tởm khác của ngươi. Ta sẽ không thương xót ngươi, cũng không tha cho ngươi.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, [aussi vrai que] je suis vivant, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, assurément, parce que tu as souillé {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire par toutes tes choses détestables et par toutes tes abominations, {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} aussi je [te] retrancherai ; et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} œil n’aura pas de pitié, et {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} non plus je n’épargnerai pas.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi, aussi vrai que je suis vivant, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, puisque tu as rendu impur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire par toutes tes idoles abjectes et toutes tes pratiques détestables, {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}} je vais t’abattre. Je ne te regarderai pas avec pitié et je ne t’épargnerai pas.
fr.R: Alors, aussi vrai que je suis vivant, dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, je vais t’abattre. Tu as rendu impur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} lieu saint avec tes idoles dégoûtantes et toutes tes autres choses dégoûtantes. Je n’aurai pas pitié de toi et je ne te ferai pas grâce.

es.L: Por tanto, vivo yo, declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, que por cuanto has contaminado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santuario con todas tus cosas detestables y con todas tus abominaciones, yo también [te] cortaré; y no tendrá piedad {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ojo, ni yo tampoco perdonaré.
es.B: Por tanto, tan cierto como que yo vivo, afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, ya que has hecho impuro {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santuario con todos tus ídolos viles y todas tus prácticas detestables, yo mismo te cortaré. No te miraré con compasión ni te perdonaré.
es.R: Por eso, tan cierto como que yo vivo, dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, te cortaré. Has hecho impuro {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} lugar santo con tus ídolos repugnantes y con todas tus otras cosas repugnantes. No sentiré lástima por ti ni te tendré compasión.

am.L: ስለዚህ ሕያው ነኝና፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ በእርግጥ በርኩሰቶችሽ ሁሉና በአስጸያፊ ነገሮችሽ ሁሉ መቅደሴን ስላረከስሽ፣ እኔ ደግሞ እቆርጥሻለሁ፤ ዓይኔም አትራራም፤ እኔም አልምርም።
am.B: ስለዚህ በሕያውነቴ እምላለሁ፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ በርኩስ ጣዖቶችሽ ሁሉና በአስጸያፊ ነገሮችሽ ሁሉ መቅደሴን ስላረከስሽ እኔ ራሴ እቆርጥሻለሁ። በርኅራኄ አላይሽም፤ አልምርሽምም።
am.R: ስለዚህ በሕያውነቴ እምላለሁ፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ እቆርጥሻለሁ። በርኩስ ጣዖቶችሽና በሌሎቹ አስጸያፊ ነገሮችሽ ሁሉ ቅዱሱን ስፍራዬን አርክሰሻል። አላዝንልሽም፤ ምሕረትም አላሳይሽም።

hi.L: इस कारण, मेरे जीवन की शपथ, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, निश्चय, क्योंकि तुमने अपनी सब घिनौनी वस्तुओं और अपने सब घृणित कामों से मेरे पवित्रस्थान को अशुद्ध किया है, मैं भी [तुम्हें] काट डालूँगा; और मेरी आँख तरस न खाएगी, और मैं भी न छोड़ूँगा।
hi.B: इसलिए, मेरे जीवन की शपथ, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, क्योंकि तुमने अपनी सब घिनौनी मूरतों और अपने सब घृणित कामों से मेरे पवित्रस्थान को अशुद्ध किया है, इसलिए मैं स्वयं तुम्हें काट डालूँगा। मैं तुम पर न तरस खाऊँगा और न तुम्हें छोड़ूँगा।
hi.R: इसलिए मैं अपने जीवन की शपथ खाकर कहता हूँ, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} कहते हैं, कि मैं तुम्हें काट डालूँगा। तुमने अपनी घिनौनी मूरतों और अपनी सब दूसरी घिनौनी चीज़ों से मेरे पवित्र स्थान को अशुद्ध किया है। मैं तुम पर न तरस खाऊँगा और न दया करूँगा।

ru.L: Поэтому, жив {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, — слово Владыки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — непременно, за то что {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} святилище ты осквернил всеми своими гнусностями и всеми своими мерзостями, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отсеку [тебя]; и не сжалится {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} око, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не пощажу.
ru.B: Поэтому, жив {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — за то что ты осквернил {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} святилище всеми своими мерзкими идолами и всеми своими мерзкими делами, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сам срублю тебя. Я не взгляну на тебя с жалостью и не пощажу.
ru.R: Поэтому, клянусь своей жизнью, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} срублю тебя. Ты осквернил {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} святое место своими отвратительными идолами и всеми другими отвратительными делами. Я не пожалею тебя и не помилую.

ja.L: それゆえ、わたしは生きている――{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。あなたがすべての忌むべきものと、すべての忌み嫌うべきもので、わたしの聖所を汚したので、必ず、わたしもまた[あなたを]切り倒す。わたしの目はあわれまず、わたしもまた惜しまない。
ja.B: それゆえ、わたしは生きている、と{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は告げる。あなたは、あらゆる忌まわしい偶像と、あらゆる忌まわしい行いによって、わたしの聖所を汚した。だから、わたし自身があなたを切り倒す。わたしはあなたをあわれみの目で見ることはなく、容赦もしない。
ja.R: だから、わたしは生きている。そのわたしが誓って言う、と{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は言う。わたしはあなたを切り倒す。あなたは、汚らわしい偶像と、ほかのあらゆるひどく汚らわしいもので、わたしの聖なる場所を汚した。わたしはあなたをかわいそうに思わず、あわれみも示さない。

decisions.choice: as I live, declares the Lord GOD: the LORD's oath
decisions.reason: The LORD swears by his own life, since there is no one greater to swear by (Hebrews 6:13). The words that follow, "surely because ...", are the form of an oath. *Ne'um*, "declares", marks the saying as the LORD's own word.

decisions.choice: detestable things: idols and the objects of idol worship
decisions.reason: The word means something loathsome, and it is used above all of idols and their rites (Deuteronomy 29:16; 1 Kings 11:5, 7). Ezekiel sets it beside "abominations" (verse 9) for what has defiled the temple, which chapter 8 shows in detail. Later uses refer back to this note.

decisions.choice: I will cut you down: the verb is uncertain
decisions.reason: The verb usually means to take away or diminish, so "I will diminish you", perhaps taking up the shaving of verse 1, or "I will withdraw", taking away the LORD's favor. Some Hebrew manuscripts have a similar verb meaning "cut down". The sense of judgment is clear either way.

decisions.choice: my eye will not pity, and I will not spare: no mercy will be shown
decisions.reason: The eye stands for the feeling roused by what one sees. The double phrase returns in 7:4, 9; 8:18 and 9:10, always to say that the time for mercy has passed.

decisions.choice: [As] I live, declares the Lord GOD (L); As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD (B); As surely as I live, says the Lord GOD (R)
decisions.reason: The oath as in Jeremiah 22:24, with *ne'um* as "declares" at Literal and Balanced and "says" at Readable, as set for Ezekiel. *Shiqqutsim* is "detestable things" / "vile idols" / "disgusting idols", the wording set for Ezekiel, and *to'evah* is as in verse 9. "My eye will not pity, and I will not spare" is kept at Literal; Balanced says "I will not look on you with pity or spare you" and Readable "I will not feel sorry for you or show you mercy", the wording to use where the phrase returns.

decisions.choice: [Kama] niishivyo, asema Bwana MUNGU (L); Hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana MUNGU (B); ... anasema Bwana MUNGU (R)
decisions.reason: The LORD's oath takes the wording of the published Jeremiah 22:24, with the book-wide "asema" (L, B) / "anasema" (R) for ne'um. Shiqqutsim are "vitu vya kuchukiza" at Literal, kept apart from "machukizo", and "sanamu za kuchukiza" at Balanced and Readable, as the terms note sets it.

decisions.choice: "내가 살아 있음을 [두고 맹세한다]. $LG의 선언이다." (L); "내가 살아 있음을 두고 맹세한다. $LG의 말이다." (B, R)
decisions.reason: The oath and the formula "declares the Lord GOD" as the term sheet fixes them; Balanced and Readable say "…의 말이다" so that no particle follows the span that would read wrongly with one of its two forms.

decisions.choice: "혐오스러운 것들" (L); "역겨운 우상들" (B); "더러운 우상들" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for detestable things, kept apart from the abominations ("가증한 일") of the same verse.

decisions.choice: [Thật như] Ta hằng sống, Chúa là CHÚA phán vậy (L); Thật như Ta hằng sống, Chúa là CHÚA phán vậy (B); ... Chúa là CHÚA phán (R)
decisions.reason: The LORD's oath as Jeremiah 22:24 publishes it, with "Chúa là CHÚA phán vậy" (L, B) / "phán" (R) for "declares the Lord GOD", kept through Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: đền thánh của Ta (L, B), nơi thánh của Ta (R); vật đáng ghê tởm (L), thần tượng gớm ghiếc (B), thần tượng ghê tởm (R)
decisions.reason: Miqdashi and shiqqutsim in the wordings kept through Ezekiel; "Nơi Thánh" with capitals stays the tabernacle's holy place.

decisions.choice: "Vivo yo, declara el Señor DIOS" (L); "Tan cierto como que yo vivo, afirma el Señor DIOS" (B); "Tan cierto como que yo vivo, dice el Señor DIOS" (R)
decisions.reason: Book-wide wording of the oath and of neum, as Isaiah 49:18 and 1:24 in Spanish

decisions.choice: "cosas detestables" (L); "ídolos viles" (B); "ídolos repugnantes" (R)
decisions.reason: Book-wide for shiqqutsim, kept apart from toevah "abominaciones"

decisions.choice: "[Aussi vrai que] je suis vivant, déclare le Seigneur DIEU" (Literal); "Aussi vrai que je suis vivant, déclare le Seigneur DIEU" (Balanced); "... dit le Seigneur DIEU" (Readable), for the whole book
decisions.reason: The oath formula from the published Samuel, fixed in the term sheet; ne'um is "déclare" at Literal and Balanced and "dit" at Readable.

decisions.choice: shiqqutsim: "choses détestables" (Literal); "idoles abjectes" (Balanced); "idoles dégoûtantes" (Readable), for the whole book
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wordings, kept apart from to'evah ("abomination") so the two Hebrew words stay distinct, as in the English.

decisions.choice: [Tão certo como] eu vivo, declara o Senhor DEUS (L); Tão certo como eu vivo, declara (B) / diz (R) o Senhor DEUS
decisions.reason: For the whole book (14:16, 18, 20; 16:48; 17:16; 18:3; 20:3 and after): the LORD's oath by his own life (m1) takes the shape Jeremiah 22:24 and 46:18 give it in Portuguese, with "Tão certo como" bracketed at Literal; ne'um is "declara" at Literal and Balanced and "diz" at Readable, as set at 2:4.

decisions.choice: coisas detestáveis (L); ídolos vis (B); ídolos repugnantes (R); o meu olho não terá piedade, e não pouparei (L)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (7:20; 11:18, 21; 20:7-8, 30; 37:23): shiqqutsim (m2) keeps one wording at each level, as the English does, kept apart from the word for abominations (verse 9). The double phrase of m4 (7:4, 9; 8:18; 9:10) is "o meu olho não terá piedade, e não pouparei" at Literal; Balanced and Readable say it plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: the oath "ሕያው ነኝና፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}" (Literal); "በሕያውነቴ እምላለሁ፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The oath recurs often in Ezekiel (14:16; 16:48; 17:16; 18:3; 20:3 ...). "declares the Lord GOD" is "ይላል ጌታ {{dn}}" after the words at every level, as the Ezekiel terms list has it; Balanced and Readable state the oath as Isaiah 49:18 does.

decisions.choice: detestable things (shiqqutsim) "ርኩሰቶች" (Literal), "ርኩስ ጣዖታት" (Balanced, Readable); "ዓይኔም አትራራም፤ እኔም አልምርም" (Literal), "በርኅራኄ አላይሽም፤ አልምርሽምም" (Balanced), "አላዝንልሽም፤ ምሕረትም አላሳይሽም" (Readable)
decisions.reason: shiqqutsim is kept apart from toʿevot ("አስጸያፊ ነገሮች"); Balanced and Readable name the idols, as the English "vile idols" does. The refusal to pity recurs in 7:4, 9; 8:18 and 9:10 with this wording.

decisions.reason: The LORD's oath "As I live" (m1) takes the wording of Isaiah 49:18, and "declares the Lord GOD" (neum Adonai YHWH) takes the prophets note's formula: की यह वाणी है at Literal and Balanced, कहते हैं at Readable. These are the forms for the oath and the formula through Ezekiel.

decisions.reason: Shiqqutsim are idols and the objects of idol worship (m2). Literal keeps "detestable things"; Balanced and Readable name them as idols, as the English does.

decisions.choice: The oath chai 'ani ne'um 'adonai YHWH: "わたしは生きている――主なる神の言葉――。" (L), "わたしは生きている、と主なる神は告げる。" (B), "わたしは生きている。そのわたしが誓って言う、と主なる神は言う。" (R); the same through the book.
decisions.reason: The LORD's oath (m1), in the forms of Numbers 14:28 and Zephaniah 2:9; ne'um follows the prophetic table (――言葉―― / 告げる / 言う), never a respect form in God's own mouth.

source.text: שְׁלִשִׁתֵ֞יךְ בַּדֶּ֣בֶר יָמ֗וּתוּ וּבָֽרָעָב֙ יִכְל֣וּ בְתוֹכֵ֔ךְ וְהַ֨שְּׁלִשִׁ֔ית בַּחֶ֖רֶב יִפְּל֣וּ סְבִיבוֹתָ֑יִךְ וְהַשְּׁלִישִׁית֙ לְכָל־ר֣וּחַ אֱזָרֶ֔ה וְחֶ֖רֶב אָרִ֥יק אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Your third by the pestilence will die and by the famine will be consumed in your midst, and the third by the sword will fall around you, and the third to every wind I will scatter, and a sword I will draw out after them.

en.L: A third of you will die by pestilence and be consumed by famine in your midst; and a third will fall by the sword around you; and a third I will scatter to every wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.
en.B: A third of your people will die of plague or perish from famine within your walls; a third will fall by the sword around you; and a third I will scatter to every wind and pursue with a drawn sword.
en.R: A third of your people will die inside the city from disease and hunger. Another third will be killed in battle outside the city. And I will scatter the last third in every direction and chase them with a sword.

pt.L: Um terço de ti morrerá pela peste e será consumido pela fome no teu meio; e um terço cairá pela espada ao teu redor; e um terço espalharei a todo vento, e desembainharei uma espada atrás deles.
pt.B: Um terço do teu povo morrerá de peste ou perecerá de fome dentro dos teus muros; um terço cairá pela espada ao teu redor; e um terço eu espalharei a todos os ventos e perseguirei com a espada desembainhada.
pt.R: Um terço do teu povo vai morrer dentro da cidade, de doença e de fome. Outro terço vai ser morto na guerra, fora da cidade. E o último terço eu vou espalhar para todos os lados e perseguir com a espada.

sw.L: Theluthi yako watakufa kwa tauni na kuangamia kwa njaa katikati yako; na theluthi wataanguka kwa upanga pande zako zote; na theluthi nitaitawanya kwa kila upepo, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaufuta upanga nyuma yao.
sw.B: Theluthi ya watu wako watakufa kwa tauni au kuangamia kwa njaa ndani ya kuta zako; theluthi wataanguka kwa upanga pande zako zote; na theluthi nitawatawanya kwa kila upepo na kuwafuatia kwa upanga uliofutwa.
sw.R: Theluthi moja ya watu wako watakufa ndani ya mji kwa magonjwa na njaa. Theluthi nyingine watauawa vitani nje ya mji. Na theluthi ya mwisho nitawatawanya pande zote na kuwafuatia kwa upanga.

ko.L: 너의 삼분의 일은 전염병으로 죽고 네 가운데서 기근으로 멸망할 것이며, 삼분의 일은 네 둘레에서 칼에 쓰러질 것이고, 삼분의 일은 내가 사방으로 흩어 버리고, 그들 뒤로 칼을 빼어 들겠다.
ko.B: 너의 백성 가운데 삼분의 일은 성안에서 전염병으로 죽거나 기근으로 멸망할 것이다. 삼분의 일은 성 둘레에서 칼에 쓰러질 것이다. 그리고 나머지 삼분의 일은 내가 사방으로 흩어 버리고, 칼을 빼어 들고 뒤쫓겠다.
ko.R: 너의 백성 가운데 삼분의 일은 성안에서 질병과 굶주림으로 죽을 것이다. 또 삼분의 일은 성 밖에서 전쟁으로 죽을 것이다. 그리고 나머지 삼분의 일은 내가 사방으로 흩어 버리고 칼을 들고 뒤쫓겠다.

vi.L: Một phần ba của ngươi sẽ chết vì ôn dịch và bị tiêu diệt vì nạn đói ở giữa ngươi; và một phần ba sẽ ngã dưới lưỡi gươm chung quanh ngươi; và một phần ba {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ rải ra theo mọi hướng gió, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ rút gươm ra đuổi theo chúng.
vi.B: Một phần ba dân ngươi sẽ chết vì dịch bệnh hoặc bị tiêu diệt vì nạn đói trong thành; một phần ba sẽ ngã dưới gươm đao chung quanh ngươi; và một phần ba {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ rải ra theo mọi hướng gió và rút gươm ra đuổi theo.
vi.R: Một phần ba dân ngươi sẽ chết trong thành vì bệnh tật và đói kém. Một phần ba khác sẽ bị giết trong chiến tranh bên ngoài thành. Còn phần ba cuối cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ rải ra khắp mọi phương và cầm gươm đuổi theo chúng.

fr.L: Un tiers de toi mourra par la peste et sera consumé par la famine au milieu de toi ; et un tiers tombera par l’épée autour de toi ; et un tiers, je le disperserai à tous les vents, et je tirerai l’épée derrière eux.
fr.B: Un tiers de tes habitants mourra de la peste ou périra de faim à l’intérieur de tes murs ; un tiers tombera par l’épée autour de toi ; et un tiers, je le disperserai à tous les vents et le poursuivrai l’épée à la main.
fr.R: Un tiers de tes habitants mourra dans la ville, de maladie et de faim. Un autre tiers sera tué au combat hors de la ville. Et je disperserai le dernier tiers dans toutes les directions, et je le poursuivrai avec une épée.

es.L: Una tercera parte de ti morirá de peste y será consumida por el hambre en medio de ti; y una tercera parte caerá a espada alrededor de ti; y una tercera parte esparciré a todos los vientos, y desenvainaré una espada tras ellos.
es.B: Una tercera parte de tu gente morirá de peste o perecerá de hambre dentro de tus murallas; una tercera parte caerá a espada a tu alrededor; y a una tercera parte la esparciré a todos los vientos y la perseguiré con la espada desenvainada.
es.R: Una tercera parte de tu gente morirá dentro de la ciudad de enfermedades y de hambre. Otra tercera parte morirá en la guerra fuera de la ciudad. Y a la última tercera parte la esparciré en todas direcciones y la perseguiré con la espada.

am.L: ሲሶሽ በቸነፈር ይሞታል፤ በመካከልሽም በራብ ያልቃል፤ ሲሶውም በዙሪያሽ በሰይፍ ይወድቃል፤ ሲሶውንም ወደ ነፋስ ሁሉ እበትናለሁ፤ በኋላቸውም ሰይፍ እመዝዛለሁ።
am.B: ከሕዝብሽ ሲሶው በቅጥሮችሽ ውስጥ በቸነፈር ይሞታል ወይም በራብ ያልቃል፤ ሲሶው በዙሪያሽ በሰይፍ ይወድቃል፤ ሲሶውንም ወደ ነፋስ ሁሉ እበትነዋለሁ፤ በተመዘዘ ሰይፍም አሳድደዋለሁ።
am.R: ከሕዝብሽ ሲሶው በከተማዪቱ ውስጥ በበሽታና በረሃብ ይሞታል። ሌላው ሲሶ ከከተማዪቱ ውጭ በጦርነት ይገደላል። የቀረውን ሲሶ ወደ ሁሉም አቅጣጫ እበትነዋለሁ፤ በሰይፍም አሳድደዋለሁ።

hi.L: तुम्हारा एक तिहाई भाग महामारी से मरेगा और तुम्हारे बीच अकाल से नष्ट होगा; और एक तिहाई तुम्हारे चारों ओर तलवार से गिरेगा; और एक तिहाई को मैं हर दिशा की हवा में बिखेर दूँगा, और उनके पीछे तलवार खींचूँगा।
hi.B: तुम्हारे लोगों का एक तिहाई भाग तुम्हारी शहरपनाह के भीतर महामारी से मरेगा या अकाल से नष्ट होगा; एक तिहाई तुम्हारे चारों ओर तलवार से मारा जाएगा; और एक तिहाई को मैं चारों दिशाओं में बिखेर दूँगा और खिंची हुई तलवार लेकर उनका पीछा करूँगा।
hi.R: तुम्हारे लोगों का एक तिहाई भाग नगर के भीतर बीमारी और भूख से मरेगा। दूसरा तिहाई भाग नगर के बाहर युद्ध में मारा जाएगा। और बचे हुए तिहाई भाग को मैं हर दिशा में तितर-बितर कर दूँगा और तलवार लेकर उनका पीछा करूँगा।

ru.L: Третья часть твоя умрёт от мора и погибнет от голода посреди тебя; и третья часть падёт от меча вокруг тебя; и третью часть {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} развею по всем ветрам и обнажу меч вслед за ними.
ru.B: Третья часть твоих жителей умрёт от чумы или погибнет от голода в твоих стенах; третья часть падёт от меча вокруг тебя; а третью часть {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} развею по всем ветрам и буду преследовать обнажённым мечом.
ru.R: Третья часть твоих жителей умрёт в городе от болезней и голода. Другая третья часть погибнет в бою за городом. А последнюю третью часть {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} рассею во все стороны и буду гнаться за ними с мечом.

ja.L: あなたの三分の一は疫病で死に、あなたのただ中で飢饉で滅び尽くす。三分の一はあなたの周りで剣に倒れる。三分の一をわたしはあらゆる風に散らし、彼らの後ろに剣を抜く。
ja.B: あなたの民の三分の一は、あなたの城壁の内で疫病で死ぬか、飢饉で滅びる。三分の一はあなたの周りで剣に倒れる。そして三分の一を、わたしはあらゆる風に散らし、剣を抜いて彼らの後を追う。
ja.R: あなたの民の三分の一は、町の中で疫病とききんで死ぬ。次の三分の一は、町の外で戦争で殺される。そして、残りの三分の一を、わたしは四方八方に散らし、剣で彼らを追いかける。

decisions.choice: a third ... a third ... a third: the three parts of the hair explained
decisions.reason: The verse explains the sign of verse 2. Those burned in the city die of plague and famine inside the walls; those struck with the sword fall around the city; those scattered to the wind go into exile, and the sword follows them.

decisions.choice: pestilence, famine and sword: the covenant curses
decisions.reason: Sword, famine and pestilence are the three judgments named together in Leviticus 26:25-26 and again and again in Jeremiah (Jeremiah 14:12; 21:7). Ezekiel names them in 5:17; 6:11-12; 7:15.

decisions.choice: pestilence, famine, sword (L); plague, famine, sword (B); disease, hunger, battle (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set in Jeremiah for "sword, famine and pestilence": "pestilence" at Literal, "plague" at Balanced, "disease" at Readable, and "war" for the sword at Readable. Here the words stand in separate clauses, so Readable says "killed in battle" and "hunger".

decisions.choice: "전염병", "기근", "칼" (L, B); "질병", "굶주림", "전쟁" (R)
decisions.reason: The covenant triad as the published Jeremiah words it (칼과 기근과 전염병; R 전쟁과 굶주림과 질병).

decisions.choice: ôn dịch, nạn đói, gươm (L); dịch bệnh, nạn đói, gươm đao (B); bệnh tật, đói kém, chiến tranh (R)
decisions.reason: The three covenant curses in the wording of Jeremiah, kept through Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: "peste", "hambre", "espada" (L, B); "enfermedades", "hambre", "guerra" (R)
decisions.reason: As Jeremiah's sword, famine and plague in Spanish

decisions.choice: tauni, njaa, upanga (L, B); magonjwa, njaa, vita (R)
decisions.reason: The three covenant curses take the published wording of Jeremiah 24:10 at each level, as the terms note sets it.

decisions.choice: a peste, a fome, a espada (L, B); a doença, a fome, a guerra (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (5:17; 6:11-12; 7:15; 12:16; 14:21 and after): the covenant disasters (m2) keep the wording Jeremiah 21:7 sets in Portuguese at each level, "a espada, a fome e a peste" at Literal and Balanced and "a guerra, a fome e a doença" at Readable, in the order each verse gives them, as the English does (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: pestilence, famine, sword "ቸነፈር", "ራብ", "ሰይፍ" (Literal, Balanced); "በሽታ", "ረሃብ", "ጦርነት" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The three judgments keep the words of Jeremiah's "ሰይፍ፣ ራብና ቸነፈር"; Readable follows its English "disease, hunger, battle".

decisions.choice: तलवार, अकाल, महामारी (L, B); युद्ध, भूख/अकाल, बीमारी (R)
decisions.reason: The covenant curses (m2) take Jeremiah's Hindi wording (Jeremiah 24:10): तलवार, अकाल and महामारी at Literal and Balanced; Readable says युद्ध and बीमारी, as the English Readable says "battle" and "disease".

decisions.choice: "мор, голод, меч" (L); "чума, голод, меч" (B); "болезни, голод, бой / война" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this triad in Ezekiel; Readable says "война" or "бой" for the sword where the English says war or battle, as Jeremiah 11:22 and 16:4 in the Russian draft.

decisions.choice: dever, ra'av, cherev "疫病", "飢饉", "剣" (L, B), "疫病", "ききん", "戦争" (R), in the Hebrew order of each verse (5:12 pestilence first; 5:17; 6:11-12; 7:15).
decisions.reason: The covenant curses (m2); the Jeremiah forms (剣と飢饉と疫病 L, B; 戦争とききんと疫病 R), kept in each verse's own order.

source.text: וְכָלָ֣ה אַפִּ֗י וַהֲנִחוֹתִ֧י חֲמָתִ֛י בָּ֖ם וְהִנֶּחָ֑מְתִּי וְֽיָדְע֞וּ כִּי־אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה דִּבַּ֨רְתִּי֙ בְּקִנְאָתִ֔י בְּכַלּוֹתִ֥י חֲמָתִ֖י בָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be spent my anger, and I will make rest my wrath on them, and I will be eased; and they will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken in my jealousy, when I spend my wrath on them.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger will be spent, and I will make {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath rest on them, and I will be eased; and they will know that I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have spoken in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} jealousy, when I spend {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath on them.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger will be spent; I will satisfy {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath on them and be appeased. Then they will know that I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have spoken in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} jealousy, when I spend {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath on them.
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger will be over. I will have poured out all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger on them, and I will be satisfied. When I have done this, they will know that I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, spoke out of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} jealous love.

pt.L: E a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira se esgotará, e farei repousar sobre eles o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} furor, e me acalmarei; e saberão que eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, falei no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} zelo, quando eu esgotar sobre eles o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} furor.
pt.B: Então a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira se esgotará; saciarei sobre eles o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} furor e me acalmarei. Então saberão que eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, falei no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} zelo, quando eu esgotar sobre eles o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} furor.
pt.R: Então a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira vai passar. Terei derramado toda a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira sobre eles e ficarei satisfeito. Quando eu fizer isso, eles saberão que eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, falei por causa do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} amor zeloso.

sw.L: Na hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itakwisha, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaituliza ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} juu yao, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitatulizwa; nao watajua ya kuwa {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimesema katika wivu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nitakapoimaliza ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} juu yao.
sw.B: Ndipo hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itakapokwisha; nitaitimiza ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} juu yao, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitatulizwa. Ndipo watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimesema katika wivu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nitakapoimaliza ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} juu yao.
sw.R: Ndipo hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itakapokwisha. Nitakuwa nimeimwaga hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} yote juu yao, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaridhika. Nitakapofanya hivyo, watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nilisema kwa sababu ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wenye wivu.

ko.L: 그리고 내 노여움이 다하고, 내가 그들에게 내 진노를 쏟아 쉬게 하면, 내 마음이 풀릴 것이다. 내가 그들에게 내 진노를 다 쏟을 때에, 그들은 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 내 질투 속에서 말하였다는 것을 알게 될 것이다.
ko.B: 그때에야 내 노여움이 다할 것이다. 내가 그들에게 내 진노를 다 쏟고 나서야 내 마음이 풀릴 것이다. 내가 그들에게 진노를 다 쏟을 때, 그들은 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 질투하는 마음으로 말했다는 것을 알게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에야 내 분노가 그칠 것이다. 나는 그들에게 분노를 다 쏟고 나서야 마음이 풀릴 것이다. 내가 이 일을 다 하고 나면, 그들은 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그들을 향한 질투하는 사랑 때문에 말했다는 것을 알게 될 것이다.

vi.L: Và cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được trút hết, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} dừng lại trên chúng, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được nguôi; và chúng sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã phán trong lòng kỵ tà của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trút hết cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên chúng.
vi.B: Bấy giờ cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được trút hết; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đổ cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên chúng cho thỏa và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được nguôi. Bấy giờ chúng sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã phán trong lòng kỵ tà của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trút hết cơn thịnh nộ trên chúng.
vi.R: Bấy giờ cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ qua đi. Ta sẽ đổ hết cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên chúng, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được thỏa lòng. Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm điều ấy, chúng sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã phán vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} muốn dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thuộc trọn về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère s’épuisera, et je ferai reposer {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur sur eux, et je serai apaisé ; et ils sauront que {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai parlé dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} jalousie, quand j’épuiserai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur sur eux.
fr.B: Alors {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère s’épuisera ; j’assouvirai sur eux {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur et je serai apaisé. Alors ils sauront que {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai parlé dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} jalousie, quand j’aurai épuisé sur eux {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur.
fr.R: Alors {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère prendra fin. J’aurai déversé toute {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère sur eux, et je serai satisfait. Quand j’aurai fait cela, ils sauront que {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai parlé à cause de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} amour jaloux.

es.L: Y se cumplirá {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira, y haré reposar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor sobre ellos, y quedaré satisfecho; y sabrán que yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, he hablado en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} celo, cuando haya consumado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor sobre ellos.
es.B: Entonces se agotará {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira; desahogaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor sobre ellos y quedaré apaciguado. Entonces sabrán que yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, he hablado en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} celo, cuando descargue {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor sobre ellos.
es.R: Entonces {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enojo terminará. Habré derramado todo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enojo sobre ellos, y quedaré satisfecho. Cuando haya hecho esto, sabrán que yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, hablé por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} amor celoso.

am.L: ቁጣዬም ይፈጸማል፤ መዓቴንም በእነርሱ ላይ አሳርፋለሁ፤ እኔም እረካለሁ፤ መዓቴንም በእነርሱ ላይ በፈጸምሁ ጊዜ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በቅናቴ እንደ ተናገርሁ ያውቃሉ።

am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ ቁጣዬ ያበቃል። ቁጣዬን ሁሉ በእነርሱ ላይ አፍስሼ እረካለሁ። ይህን ባደረግሁ ጊዜ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከቅናት ፍቅሬ የተነሣ እንደ ተናገርሁ ያውቃሉ።

hi.L: और मेरा कोप पूरा होगा, और मैं अपनी जलजलाहट उन पर ठहराऊँगा, और मुझे शान्ति मिलेगी; और जब मैं अपनी जलजलाहट उन पर पूरी कर चुकूँगा, तब वे जान लेंगे कि मुझ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपनी जलन में यह कहा है।
hi.B: तब मेरा कोप शान्त होगा; मैं अपनी जलजलाहट उन पर पूरी उतारूँगा और मुझे शान्ति मिलेगी। तब, जब मैं अपनी जलजलाहट उन पर पूरी कर चुकूँगा, वे जान लेंगे कि मुझ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपनी जलन में यह कहा है।
hi.R: तब मेरा कोप शान्त हो जाएगा। मैं अपना सारा क्रोध उन पर उँडेल चुकूँगा, और मुझे संतोष होगा। जब मैं यह कर चुकूँगा, तब वे जान लेंगे कि मुझ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपने जलन भरे प्रेम के कारण यह कहा था।

ru.L: И исчерпается {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} гнев, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} успокою свою ярость на них, и утешусь; и узнают, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, говорил в {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} ревности, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} истощу на них свою ярость.
ru.B: Тогда {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} гнев утихнет; {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} утолю на них свою ярость и успокоюсь. И тогда они узнают, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, говорил в {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} ревности, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} изолью на них свою ярость.
ru.R: Тогда {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} гнев пройдёт. Я изолью на них весь свой гнев и успокоюсь. Когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} это сделаю, они узнают, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, говорил из {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} ревнивой любви.

ja.L: そしてわたしの怒りは尽き、わたしは彼らの上にわたしの憤りをとどまらせ、わたしは気が済む。わたしが彼らの上にわたしの憤りを注ぎ尽くすとき、彼らは、わたし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がわたしのねたみによって語ったことを知る。
ja.B: こうしてわたしの怒りは尽き、わたしは彼らに対する憤りを晴らして、気が済む。わたしが彼らに憤りを注ぎ尽くすとき、彼らは、わたし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、ねたむ思いから語ったことを知るようになる。
ja.R: そのとき、わたしの怒りは終わる。わたしは激しい怒りを彼らにすべてぶちまけ、それですっきりする。わたしがこうしたとき、彼らは、わたし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、ねたむほどの愛から語ったことを知るようになる。

decisions.choice: I will make my wrath rest, and I will be eased: the anger runs its full course
decisions.reason: The words picture the LORD's anger as something that must be spent before it comes to rest. The last verb is the one for being comforted or relieved (Isaiah 1:24). They speak of God in strongly human terms, to say that the judgment will be complete and that nothing will be left undone.

decisions.choice: my jealousy: the LORD's passionate claim on his people
decisions.reason: The word means zeal, ardor, jealousy. It is the love of a husband who will not share his wife with another, and the LORD is called "jealous" in this sense in the Ten Commandments (Exodus 20:5; 34:14). His anger comes from his claim on a people who have given themselves to other gods (16:38, 42).

decisions.choice: they will know that I, the LORD, have spoken: the judgment will prove the word true
decisions.reason: This is a form of the book's refrain, "and you will know that I am the LORD" (see 6:7). When the judgment comes, they will know that the word was the LORD's.

decisions.choice: anger, wrath (L, B); anger (R)
decisions.reason: The two Hebrew words for anger are "anger" and "wrath" at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "anger" for both. Readable says "jealous love" for the sense of m2, so that the word is not heard as envy.

decisions.choice: "노여움" for anger; "진노" (L, B), "분노" (R) for wrath
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for wrath; Readable uses the plainer word, as the English uses one word, "anger".

decisions.choice: "나 $DN가 말하였다" (L); "…말했다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: God names himself without the honorific -시-; the particle 가 fits both forms of the span. The same wording serves "I, the LORD, have spoken" through the book.

decisions.choice: lòng kỵ tà của Ta (L, B); vì Ta muốn dân Ta thuộc trọn về Ta (R)
decisions.reason: "Kỵ tà" is the published word for the LORD's jealousy (Exodus 20:5; 34:14). Readable explains it as Exodus 34:14 R does; "ghen tuông" would suggest petty envy. Chemah is "cơn thịnh nộ" (L, B) / "cơn giận" (R) through Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: "furor" (L, B); "enojo" (R)
decisions.reason: Book-wide for chemah; "ira" is kept for af (anger)

decisions.choice: ghadhabu (L, B); hasira (R)
decisions.reason: Chemah, wrath, is "ghadhabu" at Literal and Balanced and the plain "hasira" at Readable, as the terms note sets it for the book; "af", anger, is "hasira" at every level.

decisions.choice: chemah "fureur" (Literal, Balanced); "colère" (Readable); 'aph "colère" at every level, for the whole book
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wordings; Readable uses one common word for both, as the English does.

decisions.choice: a ira, o furor (L, B); a ira (R); o zelo (L, B), o amor zeloso (R) for qin'ah; "ciúme" only in the marriage picture and for the "imagem do ciúme"
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the two words for God's anger are "ira" and "furor" at Literal and Balanced and "ira" at Readable, as the English (r-en-1). Qin'ah (m2), the English "jealousy" at every level, is split in Portuguese by what the picture is. Where it is the LORD's burning concern for his name, land and people (here; 36:5-6; 38:19; 39:25), it is "zelo" ("amor zeloso" at Readable, as the English Readable says "jealous love"), since "ciúme" said of God outside a marriage sounds petty in Portuguese. Where the picture is a husband wronged by a rival (16:38, 42; 23:25) or an idol that provokes the LORD as a rival does (8:3, 5), it is "ciúme", which keeps that picture. The refrain's variant "saberão que eu, o SENHOR, falei" follows the wording set for the refrain at 6:7.

decisions.choice: "እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በቅናቴ እንደ ተናገርሁ ያውቃሉ" (Literal, Balanced); "... ከቅናት ፍቅሬ የተነሣ ..." (Readable)
decisions.reason: This is the first form of the book's recognition formula, "they will know that I am the LORD"; the knowing clause is put last, "... እንደ ... ያውቃሉ", as the Ezekiel terms list gives it. Readable follows its English "jealous love".

decisions.choice: जलन (L, B); जलन भरा प्रेम (R)
decisions.reason: Qin'ah is the LORD's passionate claim on his people (m2), the "jealous God" of Exodus 34:14, which Hindi Exodus calls जलन रखनेवाला. Readable adds प्रेम, as the English Readable says "jealous love".

decisions.choice: वे जान लेंगे कि मुझ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने ... यह कहा है
decisions.reason: "They will know that I, the LORD, have spoken" (m3): Hindi says मुझ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने ("I, the LORD, [have]"), the natural form for a first person with a name. The same form is used for "I, the LORD, have spoken" in 5:15 and 5:17.

decisions.choice: कोप (af); जलजलाहट (hemah) (L, B); क्रोध (R)
decisions.reason: The two words for anger are kept apart at Literal and Balanced; Readable says क्रोध for both, as the English Readable says "anger".

decisions.choice: "ревность" (L, B); "ревнивая любовь" (R)
decisions.reason: "Ревность" is the word for the LORD's jealousy in Deuteronomy in the Russian draft; Readable says what it is, as the English "jealous love" does. Where God's "my" is the reflexive "свою", it takes no span.

decisions.choice: The recognition formula with "I have spoken": "彼らは、わたし、主が…語ったことを知る" (L), "…知るようになる" (B, R); the book-wide form for "they / you will know that I am the LORD" is "わたしが主であることを知る(ようになる)".
decisions.reason: The judgment will prove the word true (m3); Literal keeps the bare 知る, Balanced and Readable say the coming to know (ようになる). The formula recurs over seventy times; one Japanese form keeps it recognizable.

decisions.choice: qin'ah "ねたみ" (L), "ねたむ思い" (B), "ねたむほどの愛" (R).
decisions.reason: The LORD's passionate claim on his people (m2); the English R "jealous love".

source.text: וְאֶתְּנֵךְ֙ לְחָרְבָּ֣ה וּלְחֶרְפָּ֔ה בַּגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבִיבוֹתָ֑יִךְ לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־עוֹבֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will make you into a ruin and into a reproach among [the] nations which [are] around you, before [the] eyes of every [one] passing by.

en.L: And I will make you a ruin and a reproach among the nations that [are] around you, before the eyes of everyone who passes by.
en.B: I will turn you into a ruin and an object of scorn among the nations around you, for every passerby to see.
en.R: I will turn you into a ruin. The nations around you will look down on you, and everyone who passes by will see it.

pt.L: E farei de ti uma ruína e um opróbrio entre as nações que [estão] ao teu redor, diante dos olhos de todo o que passar.
pt.B: Farei de ti uma ruína e um objeto de desprezo entre as nações ao teu redor, à vista de todos os que passarem.
pt.R: Vou fazer de ti uma ruína. As nações ao teu redor vão te desprezar, e todos os que passarem vão ver isso.

sw.L: Nami nitakufanya kuwa ukiwa na aibu kati ya mataifa yanayokuzunguka, mbele ya macho ya kila apitaye.
sw.B: Nitakufanya magofu na kitu cha kudharauliwa kati ya mataifa yanayokuzunguka, kila apitaye akiona.
sw.R: Nitakufanya kuwa magofu. Mataifa yanayokuzunguka yatakudharau, na kila mtu anayepita atakuona.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 너를 네 둘레에 있는 민족들 가운데서, 지나가는 모든 사람의 눈앞에서 폐허와 치욕거리로 만들겠다.
ko.B: 내가 너를 폐허로 만들고, 네 둘레에 있는 민족들 사이에서 조롱거리가 되게 하겠다. 지나가는 사람마다 그것을 볼 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 너를 폐허로 만들겠다. 네 둘레에 있는 민족들이 너를 업신여길 것이다. 지나가는 사람마다 그 모습을 볼 것이다.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho ngươi thành một nơi hoang tàn và một sự sỉ nhục giữa các dân tộc chung quanh ngươi, trước mắt mọi người đi ngang qua.
vi.B: Ta sẽ biến ngươi thành một nơi hoang tàn và một đối tượng bị chê cười giữa các dân tộc chung quanh, cho mọi người qua lại đều thấy.
vi.R: Ta sẽ biến ngươi thành một đống đổ nát. Các dân tộc chung quanh sẽ khinh bỉ ngươi, và mọi người đi ngang qua đều sẽ thấy.

fr.L: Et je ferai de toi une ruine et un opprobre parmi les nations qui [sont] autour de toi, sous les yeux de tout passant.
fr.B: Je ferai de toi une ruine et un objet de mépris parmi les nations qui t’entourent, sous les yeux de tous les passants.
fr.R: Je ferai de toi une ruine. Les nations autour de toi te mépriseront, et tous ceux qui passeront le verront.

es.L: Y te haré una ruina y un oprobio entre las naciones que [están] alrededor de ti, a los ojos de todo el que pase.
es.B: Te convertiré en una ruina y en objeto de burla entre las naciones que te rodean, a la vista de todo el que pase.
es.R: Te convertiré en una ruina. Las naciones que te rodean te despreciarán, y todos los que pasen lo verán.

am.L: በዙሪያሽ ባሉት ሕዝቦች መካከል፣ በሚያልፍም ሁሉ ዓይን ፊት ፍርስራሽና መሰደቢያ አደርግሻለሁ።
am.B: በዙሪያሽ ባሉት ሕዝቦች መካከል ፍርስራሽና መዘባበቻ አደርግሻለሁ፤ የሚያልፍም ሁሉ ያይሻል።
am.R: ፍርስራሽ አደርግሻለሁ። በዙሪያሽ ያሉት ሕዝቦች ይንቁሻል፤ የሚያልፍም ሁሉ ያይሻል።

hi.L: और मैं तुम्हें अपने चारों ओर की जातियों के बीच, हर आने-जानेवाले की आँखों के सामने, उजाड़ और नामधराई का कारण बनाऊँगा।
hi.B: मैं तुम्हें तुम्हारे चारों ओर के राष्ट्रों के बीच उजाड़ और निंदा का पात्र बना दूँगा, ताकि हर आने-जानेवाला देखे।
hi.R: मैं तुम्हें खंडहर बना दूँगा। तुम्हारे चारों ओर के राष्ट्र तुम्हें तुच्छ समझेंगे, और हर आने-जानेवाला यह देखेगा।

ru.L: И сделаю {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} тебя развалиной и позором среди народов, которые вокруг тебя, на глазах у всякого проходящего.
ru.B: Я превращу тебя в развалины и в предмет насмешек среди народов вокруг тебя, на глазах у всякого прохожего.
ru.R: Я превращу тебя в развалины. Народы вокруг будут презирать тебя, и все, кто проходит мимо, увидят это.

ja.L: そしてわたしはあなたを、あなたの周りの国々の中で、通り過ぎるすべての者の目の前で、廃墟とし、恥辱とする。
ja.B: わたしはあなたを、周りの国々の中で廃墟とし、そしりの的とし、通りかかるすべての者の目にさらす。
ja.R: わたしはあなたを廃墟にする。周りの国々はあなたを見下し、通りかかる人はみな、それを見る。

decisions.choice: a ruin and a reproach ... everyone who passes by: the covenant curse
decisions.reason: Leviticus 26:31-33 warns that the cities will be laid waste; Jeremiah and Lamentations speak of those who pass by and are appalled at the ruined city (Jeremiah 19:8; Lamentations 2:15).

decisions.choice: will look down on you (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what being a reproach among the nations means.

source.text: וְֽהָ֨יְתָ֜ה חֶרְפָּ֤ה וּגְדוּפָה֙ מוּסָ֣ר וּמְשַׁמָּ֔ה לַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבִיבוֹתָ֑יִךְ בַּעֲשׂוֹתִי֩ בָ֨ךְ שְׁפָטִ֜ים בְּאַ֤ף וּבְחֵמָה֙ וּבְתֹכְח֣וֹת חֵמָ֔ה אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be a reproach and a taunt, a warning and a horror to [the] nations which [are] around you, when I do in you judgments in anger and in wrath and in rebukes of wrath. I, Yahweh, have spoken.

en.L: And it will be a reproach and a taunt, a lesson and a horror for the nations that [are] around you, when I do judgments on you in anger and in wrath and with rebukes of wrath. I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have spoken.
en.B: You will be a disgrace and an object of scorn, a warning and a horror for the nations around you, as I carry out judgments on you in anger and wrath and with furious rebukes. I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have spoken.
en.R: You will be shamed and mocked. The nations around you will be horrified, and they will learn a lesson from what happens to you when I punish you in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} great anger. I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have spoken.

pt.L: E ela será um opróbrio e uma zombaria, uma lição e um horror para as nações que [estão] ao teu redor, quando eu executar em ti juízos com ira, e com furor, e com repreensões de furor. Eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, falei.
pt.B: Serás uma vergonha e um objeto de zombaria, uma advertência e um horror para as nações ao teu redor, quando eu executar juízos sobre ti com ira, com furor e com repreensões furiosas. Eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, falei.
pt.R: Tu serás envergonhada e zombada. As nações ao teu redor vão ficar horrorizadas e vão aprender uma lição com o que vai acontecer contigo, quando eu te castigar com a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} grande ira. Eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, falei.

sw.L: Nayo itakuwa aibu na dhihaka, fundisho na kitisho kwa mataifa yanayokuzunguka, nitakapotekeleza hukumu juu yako kwa hasira na kwa ghadhabu na kwa makaripio ya ghadhabu. Mimi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimesema.
sw.B: Utakuwa aibu na kitu cha kudhihakiwa, onyo na kitisho kwa mataifa yanayokuzunguka, nitakapotekeleza hukumu juu yako kwa hasira na ghadhabu na kwa makaripio makali. Mimi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimesema.
sw.R: Utaaibishwa na kudhihakiwa. Mataifa yanayokuzunguka yatashtuka, nayo yatajifunza kutokana na yatakayokupata nitakapokuadhibu kwa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kuu. Mimi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimesema.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 노여움과 진노와 맹렬한 책망으로 너에게 심판을 행할 때에, 그것이 네 둘레에 있는 민족들에게 치욕과 조롱, 교훈과 공포가 될 것이다. 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말하였다.
ko.B: 내가 노여움과 진노와 맹렬한 책망으로 너에게 심판을 내릴 때, 너는 네 둘레에 있는 민족들에게 수치와 조롱거리가 되고, 경고와 공포의 대상이 될 것이다. 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말했다.
ko.R: 너는 수치를 당하고 조롱을 받을 것이다. 내가 크게 분노하여 너에게 벌을 내릴 때, 네 둘레에 있는 민족들은 겁에 질릴 것이고, 너에게 일어난 일을 보고 교훈을 얻을 것이다. 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말했다.

vi.L: Và nó sẽ là một sự sỉ nhục và một lời chế nhạo, một bài học và một nỗi kinh hoàng cho các dân tộc chung quanh ngươi, khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thi hành các sự phán xét trên ngươi trong cơn giận, trong cơn thịnh nộ và với những lời quở trách thịnh nộ. Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã phán.
vi.B: Ngươi sẽ là một nỗi nhục và một đối tượng bị chê cười, một lời cảnh cáo và một nỗi kinh hoàng cho các dân tộc chung quanh, khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thi hành các sự phán xét trên ngươi trong cơn giận, cơn thịnh nộ và những lời quở trách dữ dội. Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã phán.
vi.R: Ngươi sẽ bị sỉ nhục và chế giễu. Các dân tộc chung quanh sẽ kinh hoàng, và chúng sẽ rút ra bài học từ điều xảy đến cho ngươi khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trừng phạt ngươi trong cơn giận lớn của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã phán.

fr.L: Et ce sera un opprobre et un sujet de moquerie, une leçon et une horreur pour les nations qui [sont] autour de toi, quand j’exécuterai sur toi des jugements avec colère et avec fureur, et par des châtiments de fureur. Moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai parlé.
fr.B: Tu seras un objet de honte et de moquerie, un avertissement et un objet d’horreur pour les nations qui t’entourent, quand j’exécuterai sur toi des jugements avec colère et fureur, par des châtiments furieux. Moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai parlé.
fr.R: On te couvrira de honte et on se moquera de toi. Les nations autour de toi seront horrifiées, et elles tireront une leçon de ce qui t’arrivera quand je te punirai dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} grande colère. C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui le dis.

es.L: Y será un oprobio y un escarnio, una lección y un horror para las naciones que [están] alrededor de ti, cuando yo ejecute en ti juicios con ira y con furor y con reprensiones de furor. Yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, he hablado.
es.B: Serás una vergüenza y objeto de burla, una advertencia y un horror para las naciones que te rodean, cuando ejecute juicios contra ti con ira, con furor y con reprensiones furiosas. Yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, he hablado.
es.R: Serás humillada y despreciada. Las naciones que te rodean se horrorizarán y aprenderán una lección de lo que te pase cuando te castigue con {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gran enojo. Yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, lo he dicho.

am.L: በቁጣና በመዓት፣ በመዓትም ተግሣጽ በአንቺ ላይ ፍርድን ባደረግሁ ጊዜ፣ በዙሪያሽ ላሉት ሕዝቦች መሰደቢያና መዘበቻ፣ ትምህርትና መደንገጫ ይሆናል። እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ተናግሬአለሁ።
am.B: በቁጣና በመዓት፣ በብርቱ ተግሣጽም በአንቺ ላይ ፍርድን በፈጸምሁ ጊዜ፣ በዙሪያሽ ላሉት ሕዝቦች መሰደቢያና መዘባበቻ፣ ማስጠንቀቂያና መደንገጫ ትሆኛለሽ። እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ተናግሬአለሁ።
am.R: ታፍሪያለሽ፤ መሳለቂያም ትሆኛለሽ። በታላቅ ቁጣዬ በምቀጣሽ ጊዜ በዙሪያሽ ያሉት ሕዝቦች በአንቺ ላይ በደረሰው ነገር ይደነግጣሉ፤ ትምህርትም ያገኙበታል። እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ተናግሬአለሁ።

hi.L: और जब मैं कोप और जलजलाहट और जलजलाहट भरी डाँट के साथ तुम पर न्याय के दंड चलाऊँगा, तब वह तुम्हारे चारों ओर की जातियों के लिए नामधराई और ताना, शिक्षा और भय का कारण होगी। मुझ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा है।
hi.B: जब मैं कोप और जलजलाहट के साथ और भयंकर डाँट से तुम्हें दंड दूँगा, तब तुम अपने चारों ओर के राष्ट्रों के लिए अपमान और ठट्ठे का, चेतावनी और भय का कारण बनोगे। मुझ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यह कहा है।
hi.R: तुम लज्जित किए जाओगे और तुम्हारा ठट्ठा उड़ाया जाएगा। जब मैं अपने बड़े क्रोध में तुम्हें दंड दूँगा, तब तुम्हारे चारों ओर के राष्ट्र भयभीत होंगे, और जो कुछ तुम्हारे साथ होगा उससे वे सबक़ सीखेंगे। मुझ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यह कहा है।

ru.L: И будет [это] позором и поношением, уроком и ужасом для народов, которые вокруг тебя, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} совершу над тобой суды в гневе, и в ярости, и в яростных наказаниях. Я, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, сказал.
ru.B: Ты станешь позором и предметом насмешек, предостережением и ужасом для народов вокруг тебя, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} совершу над тобой суды в гневе и ярости и с яростными упрёками. Я, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, сказал.
ru.R: Тебя будут стыдить и высмеивать. Народы вокруг тебя придут в ужас и извлекут урок из того, что случится с тобой, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} накажу тебя в {{deity_pronoun:моём|Моём}} великом гневе. Я, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, сказал.

ja.L: そしてそれは、あなたの周りの国々にとって、恥辱となり、そしりとなり、戒めとなり、恐れとなる。わたしが怒りと憤りと憤りの懲らしめをもって、あなたに裁きを行うときに。わたし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が語った。
ja.B: わたしが怒りと憤りと激しい懲らしめをもってあなたに裁きを行うとき、あなたは周りの国々にとって、恥辱となり、そしりの的となり、戒めとなり、恐怖の的となる。わたし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が語った。
ja.R: あなたははずかしめられ、あざけられる。わたしが激しい怒りをもってあなたを罰するとき、周りの国々はそれを見て震え上がり、そこから教訓を学ぶ。わたし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がこう言ったのだ。

decisions.choice: it will be: the Hebrew; the Greek translation reads "you will be"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "it will be" (or "she will be"), meaning the city, Jerusalem. The Greek translation and others read "you will be", as the rest of the verse addresses the city. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: a warning or lesson: something for others to learn from
decisions.reason: The word means instruction or discipline. What happens to Jerusalem will teach the nations what it means to break faith with the LORD (Deuteronomy 29:23-27).

decisions.choice: I, the LORD, have spoken: the word is certain
decisions.reason: The short formula seals what has been said with the LORD's own authority. Ezekiel uses it to close the sayings of verses 13, 15 and 17 and many others (17:21, 24; 21:22).

decisions.choice: I, the LORD, have spoken (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: The formula keeps the same words at every level, so that it can be recognized each time it returns. Readable puts the four nouns into a plain sentence and says "great anger" for the three words for anger. Readable's "my" is the LORD speaking of himself and takes the setting.

decisions.choice: "Yo, el SEÑOR, he hablado" (L, B); "Yo, el SEÑOR, lo he dicho" (R)
decisions.reason: Book-wide wording of the closing formula

decisions.choice: "Serás humillada", feminine
decisions.reason: Jerusalem is addressed as a woman, so adjectives agree in the feminine

decisions.choice: "Moi, le SEIGNEUR, j'ai parlé" (Literal, Balanced); "C'est moi, le SEIGNEUR, qui le dis" (Readable), for the whole book
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for this closing formula.

decisions.choice: Eu, o SENHOR, falei (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (5:13, 17; 17:21, 24; 21:22 and after): the formula that seals a saying (m3) keeps the same words at every level, as the English does (r-en-1), so that it can be recognized each time it returns.

decisions.choice: I, the LORD, have spoken "እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ተናግሬአለሁ" at every level
decisions.reason: The closing formula recurs (5:17; 17:21, 24; 21:17 ...) and keeps the wording of Numbers 14:35 on main. Literal keeps the Hebrew's "it will be"; Balanced and Readable follow the English "you will be".

decisions.choice: मुझ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा है (L); मुझ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यह कहा है (B, R)
decisions.reason: "I, the LORD, have spoken" seals the word as certain (m3). Hindi needs the agent form मुझ ... ने; this wording is used every time in the book.

decisions.choice: वह ... होगी (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "it will be" (m1); Literal keeps the third person, while Balanced and Readable say "you", as the English Balanced does.

decisions.choice: "Я, ГОСПОДЬ, сказал." (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: The formula keeps the same words at every level, so that it is recognised each time it returns. "Я" opens the sentence and is written plainly with its capital.

decisions.choice: 'ani YHWH dibbarti "わたし、主が語った" (L, B), "わたし、主がこう言ったのだ" (R); the same at 5:17 and through the book.
decisions.reason: The word is certain (m3); a short closing formula kept the same each time.

source.text: בְּֽשַׁלְּחִ֡י אֶת־חִצֵּי֩ הָרָעָ֨ב הָרָעִ֤ים בָּהֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ לְמַשְׁחִ֔ית אֲשֶׁר־אֲשַׁלַּ֥ח אוֹתָ֖ם לְשַֽׁחֶתְכֶ֑ם וְרָעָב֙ אֹסֵ֣ף עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְשָׁבַרְתִּ֥י לָכֶ֖ם מַטֵּה־לָֽחֶם׃

records.literal_gloss: When I send the arrows of the famine the evil against them, which are for destruction, which I will send them to destroy you, and famine I will add on you, and I will break for you [the] staff of bread.

en.L: When I send against them the evil arrows of famine, which are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you, [then] famine I will increase on you, and I will break for you the staff of bread.
en.B: When I shoot at you the deadly arrows of famine, arrows meant for destruction that I send to destroy you, I will bring more and more famine on you and break your staff of bread.
en.R: I will shoot deadly arrows of hunger at you to destroy you. I will make the famine worse and worse, and I will take away your food supply.

pt.L: Quando eu enviar contra eles as flechas malignas da fome, que são para destruição, que eu enviarei para destruir vocês, [então] aumentarei a fome sobre vocês, e quebrarei para vocês o bordão do pão.
pt.B: Quando eu atirar contra vocês as flechas mortais da fome, flechas destinadas à destruição, que envio para destruir vocês, trarei sobre vocês fome cada vez maior e quebrarei o bordão do pão de vocês.
pt.R: Vou atirar contra vocês flechas mortais de fome para destruir vocês. Vou fazer a fome ficar cada vez pior e vou tirar o alimento de que vocês dependem.

sw.L: Nitakapopeleka juu yao mishale mibaya ya njaa, iliyo ya uharibifu, nitakayoipeleka kuwaangamiza ninyi, [ndipo] nitaongeza njaa juu yenu, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaivunja fimbo ya mkate kwenu.
sw.B: Nitakapowapiga kwa mishale ya kuua ya njaa, mishale ya uharibifu ninayoipeleka kuwaangamiza, nitazidi kuleta njaa juu yenu na kuivunja fimbo yenu ya mkate.
sw.R: Nitawapiga kwa mishale ya kuua ya njaa ili kuwaangamiza. Nitaifanya njaa izidi kuwa mbaya, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaiondoa akiba yenu ya chakula.

ko.L: 내가 그들에게 멸망을 가져오는 기근의 악한 화살들, 곧 너희를 멸망시키려고 내가 보낼 그 화살들을 보낼 때에, 내가 너희에게 기근을 더하고 너희에게서 빵의 지팡이를 부러뜨리겠다.
ko.B: 내가 너희를 멸망시키려고 멸망의 화살, 곧 기근의 무서운 화살을 너희에게 쏠 때에, 기근을 점점 더 심하게 하고 너희의 빵의 지팡이를 부러뜨리겠다.
ko.R: 나는 너희를 멸망시키려고 굶주림이라는 무서운 화살을 너희에게 쏘겠다. 나는 기근을 점점 더 심하게 하고, 너희가 먹을 것을 없애 버리겠다.

vi.L: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bắn những mũi tên độc hại của nạn đói nghịch cùng chúng, là những mũi tên để hủy diệt, mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bắn ra để hủy diệt các ngươi, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ gia tăng nạn đói trên các ngươi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bẻ gãy cây gậy bánh của các ngươi.
vi.B: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bắn vào các ngươi những mũi tên chết chóc của nạn đói, là những mũi tên hủy diệt mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bắn ra để hủy diệt các ngươi, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho nạn đói càng thêm nặng và bẻ gãy cây gậy bánh của các ngươi.
vi.R: Ta sẽ bắn những mũi tên chết chóc của nạn đói vào các ngươi để hủy diệt các ngươi. Ta sẽ làm cho nạn đói càng ngày càng nặng, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cất đi nguồn lương thực của các ngươi.

fr.L: Quand j’enverrai contre eux les flèches mauvaises de la famine, qui sont pour la destruction, que j’enverrai pour vous détruire, [alors] j’augmenterai sur vous la famine, et je briserai pour vous le bâton du pain.
fr.B: Quand je lancerai contre vous les flèches mortelles de la famine, des flèches destinées à la destruction, que j’enverrai pour vous détruire, je ferai venir sur vous famine sur famine et je briserai pour vous le bâton du pain.
fr.R: Je lancerai contre vous des flèches mortelles de faim pour vous détruire. Je rendrai la famine de plus en plus terrible, et je supprimerai vos réserves de nourriture.

es.L: Cuando yo envíe contra ellos las flechas malignas del hambre, que son para destrucción, que yo enviaré para {{plural_you:destruirlos|destruiros}}, [entonces] aumentaré el hambre sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:les|os}} quebraré el bastón del pan.
es.B: Cuando dispare contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} las flechas mortales del hambre, flechas de destrucción que envío para {{plural_you:destruirlos|destruiros}}, haré que el hambre {{plural_you:les|os}} aumente más y más y {{plural_you:les|os}} quebraré el bastón del pan.
es.R: Dispararé contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} flechas mortales de hambre para {{plural_you:destruirlos|destruiros}}. Haré que el hambre sea cada vez peor, y {{plural_you:les|os}} quitaré el alimento.

am.L: ለጥፋት የሆኑትን፣ እናንተንም ለማጥፋት የምልካቸውን ክፉዎቹን የራብ ፍላጾች በእነርሱ ላይ በላክሁ ጊዜ፣ ራብን በእናንተ ላይ አበዛለሁ፤ የእንጀራችሁንም በትር እሰብራለሁ።
am.B: ለጥፋት የሆኑትን፣ ላጠፋችሁም የምልካቸውን ገዳዮቹን የራብ ፍላጾች ባስፈነጠርኩባችሁ ጊዜ፣ ራብን በእናንተ ላይ እያበዛሁ እሄዳለሁ፤ የእንጀራችሁንም በትር እሰብራለሁ።
am.R: ላጠፋችሁ ገዳይ የረሃብ ፍላጾችን እወረውርባችኋለሁ። ረሃቡን እያባባስሁ እሄዳለሁ፤ የምግብ አቅርቦታችሁንም አስቀራለሁ።

hi.L: जब मैं उनके विरुद्ध अकाल के बुरे तीर भेजूँगा, जो विनाश के लिए हैं, जिन्हें मैं तुम्हें नष्ट करने के लिए भेजूँगा, [तब] मैं तुम पर अकाल बढ़ाता जाऊँगा, और तुम्हारे लिए रोटी का आधार तोड़ दूँगा।
hi.B: जब मैं तुम पर अकाल के घातक तीर चलाऊँगा, विनाश के लिए ठहराए गए तीर जिन्हें मैं तुम्हें नष्ट करने को भेजूँगा, तब मैं तुम पर अकाल को और भी बढ़ाता जाऊँगा और तुम्हारी रोटी का आधार तोड़ दूँगा।
hi.R: मैं तुम्हें नष्ट करने के लिए तुम पर भूख के घातक तीर चलाऊँगा। मैं अकाल को और भी बुरा करता जाऊँगा, और तुम्हारे भोजन का प्रबंध छीन लूँगा।

ru.L: Когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} пошлю на них злые стрелы голода, которые [несут] погибель, которые {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} пошлю, чтобы погубить вас, — [то] голод {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} умножу на вас и сломаю у вас опору хлеба.
ru.B: Когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} пущу в тебя смертоносные стрелы голода, стрелы, несущие гибель, которые {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посылаю, чтобы погубить вас, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} всё больше буду насылать на вас голод и сломаю у вас опору хлеба.
ru.R: Я пущу в вас смертоносные стрелы голода, чтобы погубить вас. Я сделаю голод всё сильнее и сильнее и лишу вас запасов еды.

ja.L: わたしが彼らに、滅びをもたらす飢饉の悪い矢、すなわちあなたがたを滅ぼすためにわたしが放つ矢を放つとき、わたしはあなたがたの上に飢饉を増し加え、あなたがたのパンの杖を折る。
ja.B: わたしは、滅びのための死の矢である飢饉の矢を、あなたがたを滅ぼすために射かける。そのとき、わたしはあなたがたにますます飢饉を臨ませ、あなたがたのパンの杖を折る。
ja.R: わたしは、飢えという恐ろしい矢をあなたたちに射かけて、あなたたちを滅ぼす。わたしはききんをますますひどくし、あなたたちの食糧をなくしてしまう。

decisions.choice: the evil arrows of famine: Deuteronomy 32:23-24
decisions.reason: In the Song of Moses the LORD says, "I will spend my arrows on them ... they will be wasted with hunger" (Deuteronomy 32:23-24). Famine is pictured as arrows the LORD shoots at his people.

decisions.choice: against them ... to destroy you: the change of person
decisions.reason: The verse speaks of the people as "them" and then as "you". Such changes are common in Hebrew prophecy and do not change the sense.

decisions.choice: break the staff of bread (L, B); take away your food supply (R)
decisions.reason: As in 4:16. The "when" of verse 15 carries on into this verse in the Hebrew, after "I, the LORD, have spoken"; every level starts a new sentence here.

decisions.choice: रोटी का आधार तोड़ना (L, B); भोजन का प्रबंध छीन लेना (R)
decisions.reason: As in 4:16.

source.text: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֣י עֲ֠לֵיכֶם רָעָ֞ב וְחַיָּ֤ה רָעָה֙ וְשִׁכְּלֻ֔ךְ וְדֶ֥בֶר וָדָ֖ם יַעֲבָר־בָּ֑ךְ וְחֶ֨רֶב֙ אָבִ֣יא עָלַ֔יִךְ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And I will send on you famine and evil beasts, and they will bereave you; and pestilence and blood will pass through you, and a sword I will bring on you. I, Yahweh, have spoken.

en.L: And I will send on you famine and evil beasts, and they will bereave you; and pestilence and blood will pass through you, and I will bring a sword on you. I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have spoken."
en.B: I will send famine and wild animals against you, and they will rob you of your children. Plague and bloodshed will pass through you, and I will bring the sword against you. I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have spoken."
en.R: I will send famine and wild animals against you, and they will take your children from you. Disease and violent death will sweep through your city, and I will bring war on you. I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have spoken."

pt.L: E enviarei sobre vocês fome e feras malignas, e elas te deixarão sem filhos; e peste e sangue passarão por ti, e trarei a espada sobre ti. Eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, falei."
pt.B: Enviarei contra ti a fome e animais ferozes, e eles te deixarão sem filhos. A peste e o derramamento de sangue passarão por ti, e trarei a espada contra ti. Eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, falei."
pt.R: Vou mandar contra ti a fome e animais ferozes, e eles vão tirar os teus filhos de ti. A doença e a morte violenta vão passar pela tua cidade, e eu vou trazer a guerra contra ti. Eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, falei."

sw.L: Nami nitapeleka juu yenu njaa na wanyama wabaya, nao watakufiwisha watoto; na tauni na damu zitapita kwako, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaleta upanga juu yako. Mimi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimesema."
sw.B: Nitapeleka njaa na wanyama wa porini dhidi yenu, nao watawanyang'anya watoto wenu. Tauni na umwagaji wa damu vitapita kati yako, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaleta upanga dhidi yako. Mimi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimesema."
sw.R: Nitapeleka njaa na wanyama wa porini dhidi yenu, nao watawaua watoto wenu. Magonjwa na vifo vya kikatili vitaenea katika mji wako, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaleta vita juu yako. Mimi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimesema."

ko.L: 그리고 내가 너희에게 기근과 악한 짐승들을 보내어, 그것들이 너를 자식 없게 할 것이다. 전염병과 피가 너를 휩쓸고 지나갈 것이며, 내가 너에게 칼을 끌어들이겠다. 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말하였다."
ko.B: 내가 너희에게 기근과 사나운 짐승들을 보내어 네 자식들을 빼앗게 하겠다. 전염병과 피 흘림이 너를 휩쓸고, 내가 너에게 칼을 끌어들이겠다. 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말했다."
ko.R: 내가 너희에게 기근과 사나운 짐승들을 보내어 네 자식들을 빼앗아 가게 하겠다. 질병과 끔찍한 죽음이 네 성을 휩쓸 것이고, 내가 너에게 전쟁을 일으키겠다. 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말했다."

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai nạn đói và thú dữ đến trên ngươi, và chúng sẽ làm cho ngươi mất con; và ôn dịch và máu sẽ đi qua giữa ngươi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem gươm đến trên ngươi. Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã phán."
vi.B: Ta sẽ sai nạn đói và thú dữ đến nghịch cùng ngươi, và chúng sẽ cướp mất con cái ngươi. Dịch bệnh và cảnh đổ máu sẽ tràn qua ngươi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem gươm đao đến nghịch cùng ngươi. Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã phán."
vi.R: Ta sẽ sai nạn đói và thú dữ đến nghịch cùng ngươi, và chúng sẽ cướp con cái khỏi ngươi. Bệnh tật và chết chóc sẽ tràn qua thành ngươi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem chiến tranh đến trên ngươi. Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã phán."

fr.L: Et j’enverrai contre vous la famine et des bêtes mauvaises, et elles te priveront d’enfants ; et la peste et le sang passeront chez toi, et je ferai venir l’épée sur toi. Moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai parlé. »
fr.B: J’enverrai contre vous la famine et les bêtes sauvages, et elles te priveront de tes enfants. La peste et le sang versé passeront chez toi, et je ferai venir l’épée contre toi. Moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai parlé. »
fr.R: J’enverrai contre vous la famine et les bêtes sauvages, et elles te prendront tes enfants. La maladie et la mort violente passeront dans ta ville, et je ferai venir la guerre sur toi. C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui le dis. »

es.L: Y enviaré sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} hambre y bestias malignas, y te dejarán sin hijos; y la peste y la sangre pasarán por ti, y traeré sobre ti la espada. Yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, he hablado».
es.B: Enviaré contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} el hambre y las fieras, y te dejarán sin hijos. La peste y la matanza pasarán por ti, y traeré la espada contra ti. Yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, he hablado».
es.R: Enviaré contra ti el hambre y los animales salvajes, y te quitarán a tus hijos. Las enfermedades y la muerte violenta recorrerán tu ciudad, y traeré la guerra contra ti. Yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, lo he dicho».

am.L: ራብንና ክፉ አራዊትን በእናንተ ላይ እሰድዳለሁ፤ ልጅ አልባም ያደርጉሻል፤ ቸነፈርና ደምም በአንቺ ውስጥ ያልፋሉ፤ ሰይፍንም በአንቺ ላይ አመጣለሁ። እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ተናግሬአለሁ።»
am.B: ራብንና የዱር አራዊትን በእናንተ ላይ እሰድዳለሁ፤ እነርሱም ልጆችሽን ይነጥቁሻል። ቸነፈርና ደም መፋሰስ በአንቺ ውስጥ ያልፋሉ፤ ሰይፍንም በአንቺ ላይ አመጣለሁ። እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ተናግሬአለሁ።»
am.R: ረሃብንና የዱር አራዊትን በእናንተ ላይ እሰድዳለሁ፤ እነርሱም ልጆቻችሁን ይወስዱባችኋል። በሽታና የግፍ ሞት በከተማችሁ ውስጥ ይሰራጫሉ፤ ጦርነትንም አመጣባችኋለሁ። እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ተናግሬአለሁ።»

hi.L: और मैं तुम पर अकाल और बुरे पशु भेजूँगा, और वे तुम्हें निर्वंश कर देंगे; और महामारी और लहू तुम्हारे बीच से होकर निकलेंगे, और मैं तुम पर तलवार चलवाऊँगा। मुझ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा है।"
hi.B: मैं तुम्हारे विरुद्ध अकाल और जंगली पशु भेजूँगा, और वे तुम्हारी सन्तान को तुमसे छीन लेंगे। महामारी और रक्तपात तुम्हारे बीच से होकर निकलेंगे, और मैं तुम पर तलवार चलवाऊँगा। मुझ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यह कहा है।"
hi.R: मैं तुम्हारे विरुद्ध अकाल और जंगली पशु भेजूँगा, और वे तुम्हारे बच्चों को तुमसे छीन लेंगे। बीमारी और हिंसक मृत्यु तुम्हारे नगर में फैल जाएगी, और मैं तुम पर युद्ध लाऊँगा। मुझ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यह कहा है।"

ru.L: И пошлю {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} на вас голод и злых зверей, и они лишат тебя детей; и мор и кровь пройдут по тебе, и меч {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наведу на тебя. Я, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, сказал.»
ru.B: Я пошлю на вас голод и диких зверей, и они лишат тебя детей. Чума и кровопролитие пройдут по тебе, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наведу на тебя меч. Я, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, сказал.»
ru.R: Я пошлю на вас голод и диких зверей, и они отнимут у тебя детей. Болезни и насильственная смерть пройдут по твоему городу, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наведу на тебя войну. Я, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, сказал.»

ja.L: わたしはあなたがたの上に飢饉と悪い獣を送る。それらはあなたから子を奪う。疫病と血があなたの中を通り過ぎ、わたしはあなたの上に剣を臨ませる。わたし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が語った。」
ja.B: わたしはあなたがたに飢饉と凶暴な獣を送り、それらはあなたから子どもたちを奪う。疫病と流血があなたの中を行き巡り、わたしはあなたに剣を送る。わたし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が語った。」
ja.R: わたしは、ききんと野獣をあなたたちに送る。それらは、あなたたちから子どもを奪う。疫病と、むごい死が町じゅうに広がり、わたしはあなたたちに戦争をもたらす。わたし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がこう言ったのだ。」

decisions.choice: famine, evil beasts, pestilence and the sword: the judgments of Leviticus 26
decisions.reason: Leviticus 26:22-26 names wild animals that rob the people of their children, then the sword, pestilence and famine. Ezekiel 14:21 calls them the LORD's "four dreadful judgments": sword, famine, wild beasts and pestilence. Revelation 6:8 takes up the same four.

decisions.choice: blood: bloodshed, violent death
decisions.reason: "Blood" here means killing and violent death, as often in Ezekiel (9:9; 22:2-4).

decisions.choice: pestilence, sword (L); plague, sword (B); disease, war (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 12. "I, the LORD, have spoken" is kept at every level (verse 15). The quotation mark closes the LORD's speech, which began in 4:16.

decisions.choice: "sobre ustedes/vosotros ... te dejarán sin hijos"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from plural "you" to the city as "you" (feminine singular) in mid-verse; L and B follow it, R keeps the singular throughout

decisions.choice: evil beasts "ክፉ አራዊት" (Literal), "የዱር አራዊት" (Balanced, Readable); bereave "ልጅ አልባ ያደርጉሻል" (Literal); blood "ደም" (Literal), "ደም መፋሰስ" (Balanced), "የግፍ ሞት" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The judgments of Leviticus 26:22 and 25; 14:15-21 repeats them.

decisions.choice: chayyah ra'ah "悪い獣" (L), "凶暴な獣" (B), "野獣" (R); dam "血" (L), "流血" (B), "むごい死" (R).
decisions.reason: The judgments of Leviticus 26 (m1); blood is bloodshed, violent death (m2).
